_Generated 2026-08-14 by /mol:map._

## Inventory (layered)

### Module list

- **`src/main.tsx`** — Browser entry point. Owns the provider stack (`MotionConfig` → `ThemeProvider` → `LocaleProvider` → `App`), bundled `@fontsource` font imports, the `styles/tailwind.css` import, and pinning `html.force-full-motion` before first paint.
- **`src/App.tsx`** — Route shell. Owns the hand-rolled client-side router (`popstate` + delegated anchor click interception + `history.pushState`), the `PRODUCT_PAGES: Record<ProductSlug, ComponentType>` map, the loading gate, page-transition `AnimatePresence`, and the "home vs. product page" chrome split (`Navbar` always, `Footer` and `PAGE_ATMOSPHERE` only off `/`).
- **`src/components/`** (shell) — Cross-route chrome and shared product-page components: `Navbar`, `Footer`, `SEOSchema`, `LocaleToggle`, `mode-toggle`, `theme-provider`, `Icons`, `FeatureIcons`, `CodePanel`, `ProductCapabilities`, `ProductLinks`, `MoleculeOverlay`. Nothing here is homepage-specific.
- **`src/components/home/`** — The `/` route tree. Owns `HomePage` (section order + hash-anchor restore), the page-wide fixed background `HomeAtmosphere` wrapping the `MoleculeField` canvas, and the shared blocks `HomeSection`, `SectionHeader`, `SectionMarker`, `SectionDots`, `MonoLabel`, `Reveal`.
- **`src/components/home/sections/`** — One file per homepage block, each rendering exactly one `HomeSection` id: `HeroSection` (`hero`), `ApproachSection` (`about`), `WhatWeDoSection` (`solutions`), `AssistSection` (`assist`), `ProjectsSection` (`applications`), `ParticipateSection` (`collaboration`), `SponsorsSection` (`trust`), `ClosingSection` (`contact`). Sections own layout only; every string arrives via `useHomeCopy()`.
- **`src/components/home/applications/`** — Applications showcase internals: `ApplicationStage` (desktop morphing band vs. touch chip+panel branch, selected by `useMediaQuery`, with local `Layer` and `EntryDetail` helpers) and `ProductMark` (the brand panel standing in for real product captures). Consumed only by `ProjectsSection`.
- **`src/components/ui/`** — Generated shadcn/Radix primitives: `badge`, `button`, `card`, `dropdown-menu`, `sheet`. Tab-indented, excluded from Biome, never hand-edited.
- **`src/pages/`** — Eleven product landings, one directory each, plus `NotFound.tsx` and the `index.ts` barrel that `App.tsx` imports.
- **`src/lib/`** — Registries and cross-cutting helpers: `routes.ts`, `ecosystem.ts`, `packages.ts`, `productAccents.ts`, `styleTokens.ts`, `typeStyles.ts`, `animations.ts`, `utils.ts`, `contact.ts`, `analytics.ts`, `syntaxHighlighter.ts`, `useMediaQuery.ts`.
- **`src/lib/home/`** — Homepage data layer, no JSX: `data.ts` (section id order, application roster, participate paths, sponsors, hrefs), `stage.ts` (shared container/heading/rule class rungs), `useActiveSection.ts` (scroll-spy hook).
- **`src/lib/home/copy/`** — Locale-keyed homepage copy: `types.ts` (the `HomeCopy` contract), `en.ts` / `zh.ts` / `sv.ts`, `assist.ts` and `applications.ts` (operator-approved English carve-outs assigned *into* each locale record), `index.ts` (`HOME_COPY` map and `useHomeCopy()`).
- **`src/lib/i18n/`** — Locale runtime: `locale.ts`, `LocaleProvider.tsx`, `chromeCopy.ts`, `catalogCopy.ts`.
- **`src/styles/`** — `brand-tokens.css` (byte-identical mirror of the zensical docs theme token file) and `tailwind.css` (Tailwind v4 `@theme` mapping, `dark` and `force-motion` variants, keyframes, base layer).
- **`src/types/`** — Ambient declarations only: `env.d.ts`, `images.d.ts`, `svg.d.ts`.
- **`src/assets/`** — Bundled image/SVG assets imported as URLs.
- **`scripts/`** — Build-time generation run by `npm run postbuild`: `postbuild.ts`, `generate-og.ts`, `og-template.tsx`, `og-meta.ts`, `prerender-html.ts`, `generate-llms-txt.ts`. Imports `src/lib` at build time; included in `tsconfig.json`.
- **`tests/`** — rstest unit tests mirroring `src/`: `test_lib/routes.test.ts`, `test_lib/catalog.test.ts` (product-registration guard, including the homepage application roster), `test_styles/tokens.test.ts`. `regressions/` is reserved for browser-driven checks and is currently empty.

### Style summary

- **Naming.** Components are PascalCase functions in PascalCase `.tsx` files (`theme-provider.tsx`, `mode-toggle.tsx` are shadcn holdovers). Hooks are `use*`. Registries and frozen data are `SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE`; derived pure helpers are camelCase. Props interfaces are `<Component>Props` and stay module-private unless a consumer needs the type.
- **Construction.** Plain function components; no classes, no `make_*` / `build_*` / `create_*` wrappers. Shared state is context plus a hook accessor; copy is read through hooks rather than threaded as props. Data modules export frozen literals (`as const`, `satisfies`) and pure derivations (`applicationHref`, `contactHref`, `pathProductSlug`) — hrefs are derived from slugs, never hand-written. Approved-copy carve-outs are spliced *into* each locale record so `HomeCopy` stays the single contract.
- **Error handling.** Provider hooks throw when used outside their provider. Lookup misses degrade to a `null` render rather than crashing. `trackPageView` no-ops without `GA_ID`. `scripts/postbuild.ts` catches, logs, and exits 1. TypeScript is `strict` with `noUnusedLocals`/`noUnusedParameters`; `any` and bare `@ts-ignore` are banned by law.
- **Styling.** Every conditional class goes through `cn()`. Colour lives only in CSS custom properties (`brand-tokens.css` → the Tailwind v4 `@theme` block). Class recipes are centralized: `styleTokens.ts` (site-wide brand/atmosphere), `home/stage.ts` (the homepage's container, block gutter, two-rung heading ladder, header grid, rule), `productAccents.ts` (per-product stops, literal strings so the JIT sees them). Locale-aware typography is *composed* from `typeStyles.ts`, never restated.
- **Motion.** All variants come from `src/lib/animations.ts`. Reduced motion has three coordinated switches: `FORCE_FULL_MOTION`, `FRAMER_REDUCED_MOTION` on `MotionConfig`, and `html.force-full-motion` pinned before first paint, which the `force-motion:` variant keys off. Page-level `scroll-behavior: smooth` is wrapped in `prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference`.
- **Imports.** `@/` → `src/`, declared in `tsconfig.json`, `rsbuild.config.ts`, `rstest.config.ts`, `components.json`. `scripts/` uses explicit `.ts`/`.tsx` extensions because it runs under `tsx`.
- **Copy discipline.** No visitor-facing string is written inline in a component.
- **Tooling.** Biome over `src` and `scripts`, with `src/components/ui/**` ignored. Rstack only: rsbuild/rspack, rsdoctor, rstest — no vite/vitest. `tsconfig.json` includes `scripts` so build-time consumers of `src/lib` types fail typecheck rather than at build.

### Layer roles

Dependency direction is strictly downward; no cycles exist today.

- **`src/main.tsx` — bootstrap.** Provider composition and global side effects. Nothing depends on it.
- **`src/App.tsx` — route/shell.** Depends on the page layer, shell components, and `src/lib`. Nothing below may import it (the catalog test reads it as text to avoid an upward import). Holds one product-registration surface.
- **`src/components/home/**` — page composition for `/`.** Depends downward on `src/lib/home/*`, `src/lib/i18n/*`, `src/lib/{animations,styleTokens,typeStyles,useMediaQuery,utils}`, `src/components/ui/`, `src/components/Icons`. `HomePage` is the only symbol crossing out. This whole tree counts as **one page** under the single-page-change law and is governed by the commercial homepage contract.
- **`src/pages/` — page composition for product routes.** Pages never import each other or the home tree, and the home tree never imports a page.
- **`src/components/` (shell) — shared presentation.** Depends on `ui/` and `lib/`. `Navbar` reaches into `src/lib/home/data` for `GITHUB_ORG_HREF` — the one homepage-data dependency held by a shell component.
- **`src/components/ui/` — primitives (generated).** Radix + `cva` + `cn()` only; wrappers belong one layer up.
- **`src/lib/` — registry/helper.** Never imports a component or page. `routes.ts`, `ecosystem.ts`, `packages.ts`, `productAccents.ts` are four product-registration surfaces.
- **`src/lib/home/` and `copy/` — homepage data sub-layer.** `data.ts` carries no JSX and no strings; `copy/` carries no structure or hrefs. The split is load-bearing: `scripts/prerender-html.ts` and `tests/test_lib/catalog.test.ts` consume both from outside React.
- **`src/lib/i18n/` — locale runtime.** `locale.ts` is leaf; consumers reach it only through the three hooks.
- **`src/styles/` — tokens.** Below all TypeScript. `brand-tokens.css` must stay byte-identical to the docs theme.
- **`src/types/` — ambient declarations.** No runtime.
- **`scripts/` — build-time, parallel to the app.** Depends downward on `src/lib`; the app never imports `scripts/`. `og-meta.ts` is a further registration surface (with `public/sitemap.xml` outside TypeScript).
- **`tests/` — verification, above everything.** Unit-only by law; browser-driven checks belong in `regressions/`.
